prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create the next text-free manuscript miniature in this series.
Medieval Georgian-Persian illuminated manuscript miniature painting for Shota Rustaveli's "The Knight in the Panther's Skin" (ვეფხისტყაოსანი). 16th–17th-century Georgian royal manuscript miniature, Mamuka Tavakarashvili / King Vakhtang VI illumination tradition blended with classical Persian-Safavid tempera miniature. Egg tempera, lapis lazuli, malachite green, vermilion, warm ochre and burnished antique gold leaf on aged ivory-parchment vellum. Stylized faceted rocky cliffs, ornamental cypress and pomegranate trees, intricately patterned arches and domes, expressive courtly figures in medieval Georgian-Eastern attire. Fine controlled contours, delicately patterned fabrics, luminous matte mineral pigments, slightly flattened layered miniature space with expressive narrative gestures. A painted manuscript scene, not photorealism, cinematic rendering, modern digital fantasy or a collage of circular portraits. Reuse referenced character faces and coloring but adapt costume to the actual chronological story scene; Tariel wears ordinary Indian court or military attire in early backstory, his panther skin belongs to his later exile. Exact horizontal 16:10 composition, preferably native 1600x1000 pixels, a single coherent scene framed for a card vignette. Soft natural painted vignette dissolving to warm aged ivory vellum at edges, modest antique-gold floral flourishes at the perimeter, no rigid border. Key faces and gestures comfortably inside the central safe area, no important content cut off. STRICTLY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO CAPTIONS, NO NUMBERS, NO INSCRIPTIONS, NO CALLIGRAPHY, NO BANNERS, NO SCROLLS, NO SIGNATURES, NO WATERMARKS anywhere. Architectural ornament must be purely floral/geometric with no pseudo-writing. If letters are narratively necessary, use a small closed plain unmarked folded paper or sealed envelope, never visible writing or rolled scrolls. All book covers/pages must be plain and unmarked. Do not show graphic blood or gore; imply violent events through gestures, context and intact clothing.
Episode 19: Letters Between Gulansharo & Kadjeti; Nestan's Letter to Tariel.
Setting: Kadjeti, an inland rock-fortress chamber with a narrow arched window above dry mountain country.
Scene: Nestan entrusts a small unmarked folded parchment packet and a patterned fragment of veil to Fatman’s discreet magical messenger inside the fortress. The messenger is shown as a modest shadowed attendant, not as a new royal hero; dawn light enters the narrow window over distant inland ridges.
Characters: Nestan-Darejan, the young dark-wavy-haired woman in reference2 with strong brows, recognizable green-and-gold robe, black gold-edged veil and emerald circlet, dignified but captive. Fatman's magical messenger is a modest HUMAN attendant in a muted dark-blue/charcoal travel cloak, shown mostly in a discreet shadowed side profile, no crown, no armor, no princely jewelry and no assertion of a new named noble face. Reference3 is only the generic silhouette role cue; do not paint a circular medallion.
Story constraints: Fatman, Avtandil and Usen are elsewhere and must not appear in this fortress chamber. The messenger’s generic silhouette identity must not become an invented named noble. Kadjeti is inland; no sea or ships at the fortress. All paper surfaces are blank and folded closed; no readable marks or scrolls.
Reference1 gives STYLE ONLY—egg-tempera mineral pigments, lapis/malachite/vermilion/ochre with antique gold illumination, fine controlled lines, patterned fabrics, faceted rocks and soft ivory vellum fade. Do not include its poet or seaside palace.
Composition: horizontal16:10 nativeapproximately1600x1000. Inside a substantial INLAND stone fortress chamber, Nestan atcenter-right passes a SMALL CLOSED COMPLETELY UNMARKED FOLDED PAPER PACKET together with a piece of patterned veil to the modest messenger atcenter-left. Hands and packet clearly readable; one small oil lamp, purely geometric arch decoration, narrow arched window looking onto DRY ROCKY MOUNTAIN RIDGES. No sea, no water, no ships outside. Fatman/Avtandil/Usen are NOT in the chamber. It is one moment of covert correspondence, no split scenes, no birds carrying writing.
STRICTLY NO TEXT, LETTERS, VISIBLE HANDWRITING, NUMBERS, CAPTIONS, INSCRIPTIONS, PSEUDO-CALLIGRAPHY, BANNERS, FLAGS, SCROLLS, SIGNATURES OR WATERMARKS. The packet must remain folded shut and blank; no rolled parchment.

visual_qa.notes: Nestan gives a blank closed packet and patterned veil to a discreet generic shadowed human messenger. Fortress window shows only dry inland mountain ridges, no sea; no misplaced Fatman/Avtandil/Usen.
